name: Gizmo OCI-MSA TX electrical eye mask at TP1
spec_reference: tx_eye_mask.md (normative text; gizmo.md §4-4 is a pointer stub)
compliance_note: Internal mask; geometry follows the OIF-CEI TX hexagon construction but this is not a CEI compliance claim.
test_point: TP1, electrical input to the MRM modulator (V_TXP − V_TXN), extracted 60 fF MRM-plus-pad load present
alignment: Eye folded over 1 UI against the ideal (jitter-free) serializer symbol clock; mean 0 V crossing at t = 0 UI.
ber_convention: Raw BER 1e-12 (FEC-free internal spec). Q = 7.034, transition density ρ = 1.
x2_construction: X2 = X1 + Y1/SR_min. SR_min is the linear-ramp slew of the §4-2 hard-max 20–80% edge (4.0 ps) at the stated Vpp: T01 = 4.0/0.6 ps, SR = Vpp/T01.

status.X1: normative — TJ(1e-12)/2 per variant (gizmo.md §3): no-FIR in 'coordinates', FIR-included in 'fir_retained'
status.X2: derived from §4-2 4.0 ps hard-max 20–80% edge and Y1; TBD_from_sim_sweep vs extracted two-pole edges
status.Y1: model-derived static ER ≥ 3.5 dB floor (399.2 mV at Q=5000), rounded to 400 mV; TBD_from_link_budget for PVT/TDEC
status.Y2: exact — Vpp/2 at the 2.0 Vppd and 3.0 Vppd sign-off swings

tap_configuration: Each swing carries two hexagon variants (gizmo.md §4-4): 'fir_retained' is the operative baseline while the FIR is in the mission path (X1 = TJ_FIR/2, DJ includes the ~0.05 UI FIR slice-DCD of §4-2; tap banks at tap-code extrema); 'coordinates'/'polygons' are the no-FIR variant for the FIR-removal study, signed off with all tap weights forced to zero. The Y2 amplitude bound applies in every configuration.

fir_retained.applies: Operative baseline while the FIR is in the mission path (gizmo.md §4/§4-4); tap banks exercised at tap-code extrema against this hexagon
Operative baseline while the FIR is in the mission path (gizmo.md §4/§4-4); tap banks exercised at tap-code extrema against this hexagon

budget_decomposition.note: Horizontal dual-Dirac from §3 no-FIR allocations at BER 1e-12. X1 equals total closure by construction.
budget_decomposition.vertical_status: Y1 not decomposed arithmetically; MRM P(V) static floor. Y2 = Vpp/2 per variant.

fir_retained.note: FIR-enabled variant: DJ adds the ~0.05 UI FIR slice-DCD booked in gizmo.md §4-2.
